components.name: System-on-Chip (SoC) Die
components.reasoning: The central semiconductor die performing all processing, graphics, and communication functions is the core and primary element within the package, always procured as a separately fabricated wafer die.

components.name: Package Substrate
components.reasoning: The multi-layer organic or ceramic substrate provides the physical and electrical interface between the SoC die and the smartphone PCB; it is a distinct manufactured component with its own supply chain.

components.name: Interposer (Silicon or Organic)
components.reasoning: Many advanced SoC packages use an interposer layer for die-to-die interconnect or to enable high-density routing, a separately fabricated component procured distinctly.

components.name: Flip Chip Solder Bumps
components.reasoning: While technically part of the assembly process, solder bumps are sometimes acquired as a separately manufactured component to facilitate flip-chip mounting, but often integrated in-house at packaging.

components.name: Encapsulation Mold Compound
components.reasoning: The protective mold compound is applied over the die and substrate assembly during packaging and may be procured from specialized polymer manufacturers, but is not always considered a discrete part.

components.name: Thermal Interface Material (TIM) Layer
components.reasoning: The TIM provides thermal conductivity between the die and heat spreader or external cooling; some packages procure TIM layers as distinct components.

components.name: Heat Spreader / Heat Sink
components.reasoning: Many SoC packages include a metallic heat spreader as a separate mechanical component to dissipate heat, supplied distinctly from semiconductor fabrication.

components.name: Wire Bonds or Microbumps
components.reasoning: Used for electrical connections in some packages as a separate subassembly or procured bonding materials, but often integrated during packaging.

components.name: Underfill Adhesive
components.reasoning: The underfill material reinforces mechanical strength between die and substrate, usually procured separately but applied during package assembly.

components.name: Integrated Passive Components (IPCs)
components.reasoning: Certain packages include embedded capacitors or resistors as separate manufactured modules or embedded layers, sometimes procured from specialist suppliers.
